channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Amy Klobuchar navigates thorny politics of immigration as first test in run for governor
item.description: The moment will test Klobuchar’s record of bipartisan work in Washington and relationships with Minnesota progressives, who want a fighter against the Trump administration.

item.title: The unprecedented challenge of prosecuting federal agents for killing Renee Good, Alex Pretti
item.description: Prosecutors, defense and civil attorneys agree it’s a legal situation unlike anything the state has ever seen.

item.title: ‘Competitive rebuild’ and QB questions: Decisions that defined Kwesi Adofo-Mensah’s Vikings tenure
item.description: The Vikings general manager was fired after four seasons marked by draft pick misses and quarterback departures.

item.title: Grammy winners riff on ICE, immigration and Minneapolis
item.description: From Bad Bunny and Billie Eilish to Bon Iver and classical musicians, artists spoke up at the ceremony in Los Angeles.

item.title: Timberwolves’ Anthony Edwards named NBA All-Star for fourth year in a row
item.description: He was chosen as a reserve after falling short as a starter and is the Wolves’ only All-Star representative.

item.title: Johnson says no quick House vote to end partial shutdown and blames Democrats for their ICE demands
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson said Sunday it will be a few days before a government funding package comes up for a vote, all but ensuring the partial federal shutdown will drag into the week as Democrats and Republicans debate reining in the Trump administration's sweeping immigration enforcement operations.

item.title: They said they weren’t close to Epstein. New documents show otherwise.
item.description: Materials released by the Justice Department revealed that leading business and political figures had enduring relationships with the disgraced financier.

item.title: Pardoned auto shop owner freed after rare government reversal
item.description: Fong Khang spent seven days in detention despite being a legal resident and receiving clemency for past crimes.

item.title: The latest: Musicians call out ICE actions in Minnesota at the Grammy Awards
item.description: Some artists wore “ICE OUT” buttons or mentioned immigration during speeches and red carpet appearances on Sunday.

item.title: Meet Minnesota’s athletes competing at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy
item.description: Minnesota will be well represented, with 37 Team USA athletes with connections to the state at the Milan Cortina Games from Feb. 4-22.
